messages:
oliver: Quick bug: onboarding sample app using JSON mode + streaming blows up with JSONDecodeError mid-stream.
neha: Are you sure it's not NDJSON vs single JSON?
oliver: Positive. Model sends a single top-level array but chunks are partial so our helper calls json.loads on each feed and crashes.
neha: Oh, we added eager validation in helpers recently. That breaks streaming. Temporary workaround: set validate_mode="none" on the StreamingHelper.
qa-bot: Ticket created #433 referencing sample logs and stack trace.
sam: Proposed fix: change StreamingHelper to use a brace-aware incremental buffer and only run full schema validation at finalize, with an opt-in incremental_syntax_check.
neha: Also detect NDJSON by looking for '\n{' patterns and validate per-line when detected.
oliver: I'll add a tiny test that splits valid JSON at random offsets to avoid regressions.
sam: Thanks — assign reviews to @neha and @oliver.
